 This Crl.P Is Filed Under Section 482 Cr.Pc (Filed
U/S 528 Bnns) Praying To (A) Quash The Fir Dated
21.03.2020 Produced At Annexure-A Registered By The
1St Respondent Police Station In Crime No.104/2020
For The Alleged Offence Under Sections 498A Of Ipc
And 3 And 4 Of D.P Act And Etc.
 This Petition, Coming On For Admission, This Day,
Order

WAS MADE THEREIN AS UNDER:
CORAM: HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE M.NAGAPRASANNA  ORAL ORDER Learned Addl.
SPP submits that the charge has been framed in the year 2023 and the trial is in progress.

2. In that light, this Court would not lend its protective hands to the petitioners under Section 482 of the Cr.P.C.
3.

Learned counsel appearing for the petitioners would now submit that one of the petitioners is selected for the post of Police Sub-Inspector and the second respondent is not appearing before the Court and divorce also has been granted on the ground of cruelty.

In that light, the concerned Court shall endeavour to conclude the proceedings within three (3)
months from the date of receipt of a copy of this order, if not earlier.
With the aforesaid observations, the petition stands disposed.

Sd/-
